title: Employment advice
intro: Our Free Legal Advice Centre offers one-off advice on non-urgent employment matters through volunteer trainee solicitors supervised by Toynbee Hall staff and partner City law firms.

blocks.heading: Issues we may be able to advise on
paragraphs: Unfair dismissal, redundancy pay, workplace procedures, discrimination at work, trade union rights and whistleblowing. We cannot advise employers or Toynbee Hall employees, and cannot provide advocacy or representation.

blocks.heading: Important time limits
paragraphs: Employment Tribunal deadlines are often three months from the issue or the end of employment. Include key dates when you contact us. We cannot assist with urgent matters.

blocks.heading: How to get help
paragraphs: Email flac@toynbeehall.org.uk or call 0800 808 5701 (8am–8pm, seven days a week). The Customer Care Team will direct you to the Free Legal Advice Clinic. Appointments may be in person, online or by phone.
